verdict.rationale: Fellow's official MCP Server lets users ask questions about their meetings in plain language through AI assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor, without writing code. The pricing page also lists an "Ask Fellow" feature. The evidence only shows natural-language querying of meeting data, not issuing commands that operate the product. missing for 10: evidence of natural-language commands that perform actions (e.g., editing notes, completing action items, controlling recording), in-product details of Ask Fellow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Fellow's Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server allows you to ask your AI Assistant about your meetings, without needing to write any code.
Ask anything about your meetings - Get answers to questions like "What were my action items this week?" or "What did we decide in last month's standup?"
Your favorite AI chatbot like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can now tap directly into your meeting recaps, notes, and action items
